verdict.rationale: Feitian ships official management tools: SK Manager manages the key's FIDO, PIV and OTP functions and configures PIV, an OTP Tool switches protocols, and iePassManager on Android handles FIDO PIN and credential operations. Nothing in the evidence shows any of these is a command-line or scriptable interface, so only the management side of the story is covered. Missing for 10: evidence of an official CLI, scriptable/automatable operation, explicit slot management and device-state reading commands, and documentation of a command reference.
